$comment: AI-03 model lock. Every task type is pinned to one model id. The Claude 5 family has no dated variant: the bare id (e.g. claude-opus-5-5) is the immutable snapshot published by Anthropic. The last entry of `approvals` must match the model in registry.ts. Changing the model means appending an approval with a change request and a passing regression on the task type's test dataset (scripts/ai-regression.mjs); test [AI-03] in services/ai-runtime/test/model-lock.test.ts enforces it. The first approval has nothing to regress against.
